description: Issue #3 — Vehicle Registration and Ownership Enforcement. Fixes VehicleController's getVehicle/{id} and searchByPlate to enforce ownership (customers can only see their own), fixes VehicleService.deactivateVehicle to also allow PARKING_ATTENDANT, adds getVehicleById(Long, User) and getByLicensePlate(String, User) overloads with ownership logic in the service layer, fixes VehicleRequest license plate validation pattern to accept lowercase input (service already normalizes to uppercase), and adds full test suite for vehicle scenarios. Depends on FEAT-001 (H2 + exception handler). Independent of FEAT-002 — can be implemented after FEAT-001 in any order, but is placed after FEAT-002 for clean sequential execution.
steps: Modify VehicleRequest.java: change the @Pattern regexp from '^[A-Z0-9\\-]{2,20}$' to '^[A-Za-z0-9\\-]{2,20}$' so lowercase plates pass validation (the service normalizes to uppercase via toUpperCase() before persisting — the pattern restriction to uppercase-only rejects valid lowercase input before normalization can happen). Update the message to 'License plate must be 2-20 alphanumeric or hyphen characters'. File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\main\java\com\vps\dto\VehicleRequest.java.

Modify VehicleService.java — add ownership-aware getVehicleById(Long vehicleId, User requester): load Vehicle from repository (throw IllegalArgumentException('Vehicle not found') if absent), check if requester is CUSTOMER and vehicle.getUser().getId() != requester.getId() — if so throw SecurityException('Not authorized to view this vehicle'). ADMINISTRATOR and PARKING_ATTENDANT may see any vehicle. Return toResponse(vehicle). File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\main\java\com\vps\service\VehicleService.java.

Modify VehicleService.java — add ownership-aware getByLicensePlate(String licensePlate, User requester) overload: load Vehicle by normalized plate (throw IllegalArgumentException if not found), apply same ownership rule as step 2. Preserve the existing zero-argument getByLicensePlate(String) for internal service use (called by ParkingService and ReservationService — do NOT remove it). File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\main\java\com\vps\service\VehicleService.java.

Modify VehicleService.java — fix deactivateVehicle: change the staff role check from 'requester.getRole() != User.Role.ADMINISTRATOR' to 'requester.getRole() != User.Role.ADMINISTRATOR && requester.getRole() != User.Role.PARKING_ATTENDANT'. This allows parking attendants to deactivate vehicles per the SRS requirements, matching the pattern already used in GET all vehicles. File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\main\java\com\vps\service\VehicleService.java.

Modify VehicleController.java — fix getVehicle(@PathVariable Long id): inject @AuthenticationPrincipal UserDetails and resolve the User via authService.getUserByEmail(). Replace the stream-over-all-vehicles logic with a call to vehicleService.getVehicleById(id, user). File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\main\java\com\vps\controller\VehicleController.java.

Modify VehicleController.java — fix searchByPlate(@RequestParam String plate): inject @AuthenticationPrincipal UserDetails, resolve User, call vehicleService.getByLicensePlate(plate, user) (the new two-argument overload). File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\main\java\com\vps\controller\VehicleController.java.

Create VehicleServiceTest.java. Use @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class). Mock VehicleRepository and AuditLogService. Build helper methods: makeUser(id, role) and makeVehicle(id, ownerId). Test cases: (1) addVehicle_success — plate not duplicate, verify saved vehicle has uppercase plate and correct owner. (2) addVehicle_duplicatePlate — existsByLicensePlate=true — assert throws IllegalArgumentException. (3) getVehicleById_ownerCanSeeOwnVehicle — requester is CUSTOMER, vehicle.user.id == requester.id — assert returns response. (4) getVehicleById_customerCannotSeeOtherVehicle — requester is CUSTOMER, vehicle.user.id != requester.id — assert throws SecurityException. (5) getVehicleById_adminCanSeeAnyVehicle — requester is ADMINISTRATOR — assert returns response. (6) getVehicleById_parkingAttendantCanSeeAnyVehicle — requester is PARKING_ATTENDANT — assert returns response. (7) getByLicensePlate_ownerSees — CUSTOMER requester owns the vehicle — assert returns response. (8) getByLicensePlate_customerCannotSeeOther — assert throws SecurityException. (9) deactivateVehicle_ownerCanDeactivate. (10) deactivateVehicle_parkingAttendantCanDeactivate — assert no exception. (11) deactivateVehicle_customerCannotDeactivateOther — assert throws SecurityException. (12) updateVehicle_ownerCanUpdate — assert updated. (13) updateVehicle_customerCannotUpdateOther — assert throws SecurityException. File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\test\java\com\vps\service\VehicleServiceTest.java.

Create VehicleControllerTest.java. Use @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment=RANDOM_PORT) + @AutoConfigureMockMvc + @ActiveProfiles("test"). Register two users (customer A and customer B) and one vehicle belonging to customer A. Test cases: (1) POST /api/v1/vehicles — authenticated as customer A with valid body — assert HTTP 201. (2) POST /api/v1/vehicles — with duplicate plate — assert HTTP 400 or 409. (3) GET /api/v1/vehicles — customer A — assert only own vehicles returned. (4) GET /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicleAId} as customer A — assert HTTP 200. (5) GET /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicleAId} as customer B — assert HTTP 403. (6) GET /api/v1/vehicles/search?plate=... as customer A — assert HTTP 200. (7) GET /api/v1/vehicles/search?plate=... as customer B — assert HTTP 403. (8) DELETE /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicleAId} as customer B — assert HTTP 403. (9) POST /api/v1/vehicles with lowercase plate (e.g. 'ka01ab1234') — assert HTTP 201 and stored plate is uppercase 'KA01AB1234'. File: c:\Users\thrup\OneDrive\Desktop\SE\Project-Team-10\src\backend\src\test\java\com\vps\controller\VehicleControllerTest.java.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/vehicles/{id} returns 403 when a CUSTOMER requests a vehicle they do not own.
GET /api/v1/vehicles/search returns 403 when a CUSTOMER requests a plate they do not own.

ADMINISTRATOR can call GET /api/v1/vehicles/{id} for any vehicle.
mvn test passes all VehicleServiceTest and VehicleControllerTest cases.
